title: Recipe 71 — Building agent loops visually in Studio

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “A visual builder is only trustworthy if it round-trips to the same spec you'd have written by hand. That's what this checks.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the builder's preview runs the spec for real.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the artifact the builder produces

beats.label: Type a loop spec
beats.cue: “Whatever you draw in the builder, this is what comes out — an ordinary spec, in your repo, in your diff.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “The builder can't emit anything lint won't accept. Same gate as a hand-written spec.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “And this is what the canvas actually draws — the IR, laid out. The picture is a view of the spec, not a second source of truth.”

verify.note: IR written to live/ir.json — the graph-layout input

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Nodes and edges. Everything the builder shows you is derivable from this.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. A visually-built loop is a real bundle, with no builder runtime attached to it.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “Nothing in here mentions Studio. You can delete the builder and this still runs.”

beats.label: Prove the round trip
beats.cue: “Re-emit the IR and compare: the spec → IR → spec path is lossless, which is what makes visual editing safe.”
beats.command: crewhaus compile live/crewhaus.yaml --emit-ir > live/ir2.json; diff live/ir.json live/ir2.json

verify.note: identical IR on re-emit — deterministic lowering

groups.title: One more thing · open the builder

beats.label: Install the builder
beats.cue: [manual] “The PWA lives in its own checkout — a human clones and installs it.”

verify.note: run inside the studio-pwa checkout, which is not part of this repo

beats.label: Start it
beats.cue: [manual] “Then open a browser, drop this spec on the canvas, and drag an edge.”

verify.note: serves the builder UI; a human drives the canvas

beats.label: Diff what it wrote
beats.cue: [manual] “The test of any visual builder: does its output survive `git diff` review? Read the change it made.”

verify.note: compare the builder's edit against the spec you started from

beats.label: Read the round-trip guarantees
beats.cue: “What the builder promises to preserve, and where it will tell you it can't.”
